title: El Paso Officers Exchange Gunfire With Armed Suspect
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
El Paso, Texas — On June 1, 2025, El Paso Police Officers responded to a report of a family fight in progress at the 6400 block of Passo Via. Upon arrival to the scene, officers were directed towards a residence down the street. Officers walked towards the residence, when the offender, 35-year-old Salvador Valdiviezo, walked out of the house with a gun and pointed it towards officers. Gunfire was exchanged and Valdiviezo was shot. One of the officers sustained a gunshot wound to her right leg during the exchange. The officer was transported in stable condition to University Medical Center of El Paso. Vadiviezo was transported to a hospital and died of his wounds. Valdiviezo was a registered nurse at Three Crosses Regional Hospital in Las Cruces and had served in the U.S. Navy, according to an obituary.
